# legacy-tool

**legacy-tool** shipped the first generation of the data-transform pipeline
that [gadget](/acme/gadget) now replaces. It remains published so existing
automation keeps resolving, but it receives security fixes only.

## Migrating

The command surface is compatible for the common cases:

```sh
# old
ocx run acme/legacy-tool -- convert input.json
# new
ocx run acme/gadget -- --from json --to yaml < input.json
```

Prefer `acme/gadget` for all new work.
